technical_and_design_decisions: Implement Rabbit sink batching using Spring AMQP's BatchingStrategy and channel batching capabilities.
Use Gradle's Java Platform plugin to manage Spring XD module dependencies as provided scope.
Configure Spring Boot's MODULE layout using the boot plugin with appropriate packaging settings.
Extend compression support by introducing a configurable CompressionStrategy interface with default and custom implementations.
Use JMH (Java Microbenchmark Harness) for performance benchmarking of Rabbit sink with batching and compression.
Implement DIRT runtime configuration to optionally disable database initialization via conditional bean registration.
Create a processor module implementing Spring XD's core interface contract using RxJava for reactive stream processing.
assumptions: The development environment is already set up with Java 17+, Spring Framework 6.0+, and Spring XD dependencies.
Existing Rabbit sink and compression modules are available for extension.
CI infrastructure supports running acceptance tests for hdfs-dataset module.
Performance benchmarking tools and baseline data are accessible.
RxJava 3.x is the target version for the processor module implementation.
Gradle build scripts are based on existing Spring XD project structure.
